questions.q: The sum of the current ages of Vishal and Armaan is 70 years. 5 years ago, Vishal was twice as old as Armaan. What is Armaan’s current age?
questions.solution:
Let Arman’s current age is = X

Vishal’s current age = 70 - X

Arman’s age 5 years ago = X - 5

Vishal’s age 5 years ago = 70 - X - 5 = 65 - X

According to condition given is question

2(X - 5) = 65 - X

2X - 10 = 65 - X

3X = 75

X = 25

Hence, Arman’s current age is 25 years.

questions.q:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

4 × 5 - 24 ÷ 12 + 8 = 14
questions.solution:
Interchanging + and -

4 × 5 + 24 ÷ 12 - 8 = 20 + 2 - 8

22 - 8 = 14

Interchanging ÷ and ×

4 ÷ 5 - 24 × 12 + 8 = 54​ - 288 + 8

54​ - 296 ne 14

Interchanging × and +

4 + 5 - 24 ÷ 12 × 8 = 9 - 2 × 8

9 - 16 ≠ 14

Interchanging + and ÷

4 × 5 - 24 + 12 ÷ 8 = 20 - 24 + 23​

- 4 + 23​ ne 14

Hence by interchanging + and - we get correct equation.

questions.q: Which state of India has the longest mainland coastline?

questions.q: The term 'Dolphin Kick' is associated with which sport?
questions.solution:

• This technique is not just about the legs but It requires a swimmer's entire body to crack like a whip, creating a fluid wave that starts at the chest and increases in amplitude as it travels all the way through the toes, and it seems like a dolphin that's why it is called Dolphin kick.

• The Dolphin Kick is assumed as the fastest way to get from one point to another underwater but it needs a lot of practice as it is a very difficult move.

• The international rules for swimming disciplines are laid down by Federation Internationale de Natation (International Swimming Federation) FINA.

• There are four standard strokes in swimming a front crawl, backstroke, breaststroke, and butterfly.

questions.q: Blue litmus paper turns  on contact with an acidic solution.
questions.solution:
• Litmus paper test is done to find whether a solution is Acidic or Basic in nature.

• Litmus paper is a type of pH paper made by treating paper with natural dyes from lichens.

• The blue litmus paper turns red or pink when it comes into contact with an acidic solution of pH value below pH 4.5

• It becomes purple if the pH of the solution is between 4.5 and 8.3 and if the pH is above 8.3 it stays blue.

• The solution which is Basic in nature having a pH range between 8.5 and 14 changes the colour of red litmus paper to blue.

questions.q: Rajat has hypermetropia. What type of lens will the ophthalmologist recommend to correct his vision?
questions.solution:
Concept:

Defects of Vision

Details

Corrections

Hypermetropia or Farsightedness

The human eye can see distant objects clearly but cannot see nearby objects clearly.

Convex Lens

Presbyopia

In this defect both near and far objects are not clearly visible. It is an old age disease and it is due to the loosing power of accommodation.

Bifocal lenses

Astigmatism

In this defect, the eye cannot see horizontal and vertical lines clearly, simultaneously. It is due to the imperfect spherical nature of the eye lens.

Cylindrical lens

Explanation:

From the above explanation, we can see that,

• A person with hypermetropia can see distant objects clearly but cannot see nearby objects distinctly.

• Hypermetropia is also known as farsightedness. Such a person has to keep a reading material much beyond 25 cm from the eye for comfortable reading.

• Hypermetropia defect can arise mainly due to two reasons (i) the focal length of the eye lens become too long or (ii) the eyeball becomes too small.

• This defect can be corrected by using a convex lens of appropriate power.



• A concave lens is used for the correction of Myopia which is also known as near-sightedness.

• The bifocal lens can be used for the correction of Presbyopia (a person suffering from both myopia and hypermetropia).

• Progressive lenses also called multifocal lenses are the lenses that have a seamless progression of added magnifying power for intermediate and near vision.

questions.q: Name the tissue that transports food to various parts of a plant.
questions.solution:
• Phloem is a vascular tissue through which the food prepared by the leaves is transported to various organs of the plants.

• Phloem is a composition of four types of cells Sieve tubes, Companion cells, Pholeom parenchyma, and phloem fibers.

• Xylem is a water-conducting tissue of vascular plants which consists of dead hollow cells in the form of fibers and sclereids.

• Parenchyma are the simple permanent tissues whose cells are usually isodiametric but in various organs, due to pressure and surface tension of the neighborhood cells, their shapes sometimes change. These tissues store the foodstuffs and the parts of the leaf mesophyll, endosperms, fruit pulp etc are made from the parenchyma.

• Sclerenchyma are also the simple permanent tissues which are scattered in the organs of the plants to provide mechanical support and rigidity to the plant organs.

Important Points

questions.q: What is the value of x so that the seven digit number 91876x2 is divisible by 72?
questions.solution:
Number 91876x2is divisible by 72, so we can say number also divisible by both 8 and 9

Divisibility law of 8 ⇒ A number divisible by 8 if its last three digit is divisible by 8

If the height of two triangles are same then

questions.q: The price of sugar is increased by 17%. A person wants to increase his expenditure by 7% only. By what percentage, correct to one decimal place, should he reduce his consumption?
questions.solution:

Price of sugar after increased = 100x × [117/100] = 117x

Person wants his expenditure increase by 7% only, so his expenditure should be = 100x × [107/100] = 107x

Required percentage = [(117 – 107x)/117] × 100 = 8.54% ≈ 8.5%

questions.q: A train without stoppage travels with an average speed of 80 km/h and with stoppage, it travels with an average speed of 64 km/h. For how many minutes does the train stop on an average per hour?
questions.solution:
Given:

A train without stoppage travels with an average speed of 80 km/h and with

the stoppage, it travels with an average speed of 64 km/h

Calculation:

Without stoppage average speed = 80 km/h

With stoppages average speed = 64 km/h

As we know,

The time of rest per hour is equal to the difference in average speed divided by the

speed without stoppage.

Required time = [(80 – 64)/80] × 60 = 12

Hence, the train stops at an average of 12 minutes/hr.

questions.q: A is 50% more efficient than B and C is 40% less efficient that B. Working together, they can complete a task in 20 days. In how many days will C alone complete 30% of that task?
questions.solution:
Let the efficiency of B be 100

Efficiency of A will be = 100 × [150/100] = 150

Efficiency of C will be = 100 × [60/100] = 60

Efficiency ratio of A, B and C = 150 : 100 : 60 = 15 : 10 : 6

Total work = (15 + 10 + 6) × 20 = 620

30% of total work = 620 × [30/100] = 186

30% of total work C will complete in = 186/6 = 31 days

questions.q: In a circle with centre O, AB is the diameter and CD is a chord such that ABCD is a trapezium. If ∠BAC = 28°, then ∠CAD is equal to:
questions.solution:
Given, ∠BAC = 28°

⇒ ∠ACB = 90° [Angle in a semicircle is 90]

In ΔACB

⇒ ∠ACB + ∠CBA + ∠BAC = 180°

⇒ ∠CBA = 180° – 90° – 28° = 62°

⇒ ∠DCA = ∠CAB = 28° [Alternate interior angle]

⇒ ∠DCA = ∠ABD = 28° and ∠CAD = ∠DBC

∵ Two inscribed angles forming the same arc or forming two equal arcs are equal

⇒ ∠CBA = ∠DBC + ∠ABD

⇒ 62° = ∠DBC + 28°

⇒ ∠DBC = 62° – 28° = 34°

⇒ ∠CAD = ∠DBC = 34°
